question: Which of the following musicians is popularly known as ‘Panchamda’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RD Burman**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **RD Burman** is popularly known as '**Panchamda**'.
 
• He was an influential Indian film score composer, and one of the seminal music directors of the Indian film industry.
 
• He composed music for 331 films and is considered one of the most versatile music composers of his time.
